clips.title: The story
paras: Caravans and travelers crowd the Southern Gold Road as it runs through the Barrens toward the Great Lift. Trade links the central plains with distant reaches of Kalimdor.

At the stone bridge between the northern and southern Barrens, the Southern Gold Road turns south toward the Great Lift and Thousand Needles. Like the northern stretch, simply called the Gold Road, it takes its name from the lucrative merchant caravans that travel its length. Quilboar tribes and prowling predators harass those who use it, yet the road remains one of the continent’s busiest long-distance routes. Goods pass along it between remote outposts and ports.

Horde couriers and patrols share the Southern Gold Road with merchants and explorers bound for distant lands. Travelers journey between Gadgetzan in the southern deserts of Tanaris, Auberdine on the shores of Darkshore, and Nighthaven, among the sacred groves of Moonglade. For those crossing Kalimdor’s interior on foot, surviving the journey down this sun-baked road is a grueling rite of passage.
